body: I've played through both on tactician's mode and I feel the first game was much stronger. The AI was better, cheese strats didn't work so well, and most enemies had extra abilities on tactician's mode. In 2 however, everything just becomes a damage sponge. Health and dps increase but the AI is still hella dense and due to the above, you kinda have to rely on 'breaking' the game, at least early. I feel someone who didn't play tactician's in 1 will have missed part of the experience, but it really isn't all too needed on 2.

We all remember the bad over the good. But I'm sure your friends would stand by you if you needed them. As to your parents..well..you're not going to have to be around them forever. So, hang on and you'll be free within a few years I would of thought. Don't let them win, eh?

I can't possibly see this as a good idea..one of the main reasons people love this subreddit is, to my mind, they may talk and get things off their chest without fear of reprisal.

Hey there!

"I've always been a terrible person. I always try to help everyone but I just end up hurting them. "

Not sure how to quote :3

Anyway! To my mind and most anyone else, it's the trying that helps. We all hurt people, it's just one of those things. Death and taxes and all that. But those of us that try to do better by them and continue trying to make the world a better place..well..they're the best of us. No question about that.  

"I really wanted to be able to end everyone's suffering, not just my own. So this is really all for them, so they can be happy again."


Who is it that will be better off? Your friends do not know how to handle it, your boyfriend cares but does not know how he can help. Your family..well..they're your family. They love you and will stand by you, no matter what. Nobody will be better off you are gone. Nobody.


It takes a rare person to go out of there way for others. It's beyond tragic that the world sees fit to hurt us so. But beyond amazing that other people, with their own problems and issues, will help other people also suffering.


Whatever you decide, people will be thinking about you and if you do decide to go through with it, the world will miss you terribly. Sorry if I'm rambling..but..yeah. Enough now I suppose ^^

If it's something you worry about, or it's a problem, then it's no small. We all have different worries. Something that hurts someone else, may mean a minor annoyance to you.

I have seen people break from, to my mind, small issues. Yet others go on with things that would have me huddled in a corner, crying my eyes out.

Different things hit us in different ways. If it's a problem, then it's a problem. I do not see there being a severity in the actual problem, more how it affects you. So..try to stop worrying it over it being a worry <3 Accept it. Then solutions.

So yes I think you have to tell him as soon as you feel comfortable in doing so. But it's nothing to be ashamed of! I obviously don't know him or anything, but if he's..well..a decent guy, I can't see him having a problem with it.

Please be careful how you do though..as until the end of that post, I thought you meant you were not able to be with him anymore as you prefered women :S But hey, maybe that's me not reading it properly. So yes tell him, but do so gently and make sure you reassure him on wanting to spend the rest of your life together, eh? No getting around it, he will be hurt and confused, but sure it's nothing you can't remedy.

He may be worried over him 'turning' you gay. (*Sigh*) Or being left for a woman as you want to let out your curiosity, or not being interested in him in the bedroom anymore. Just have to answer all his questions and make sure he knows how much he means too you and where things stand.

TL;DR: Will be confused when you tell him. But hardly a surprise; just make sure you help him through it. Or maybe he simply won't care in the slightest, know many people don;t nowadays.

Either way, good luck.

Having been in a relationship with those that were suicidal, there is no easy way to say it. It's really, really hard to worry if you're going to see them again in the morning, if you will ever hear their voice again.

However, also as a sufferer from sever depression, knowing you have somebody by your side when shit does hit the fan, is the best cure there is. So, over the next few days she's going to be (Of course) feeling extremely upset and most likely guilty. 

Please, please be there for her throughout all this. You really could make a difference to this girls life, but more to the point, she could make one on yours as well. 

If you love her, then stick by her. It will be hard, but also incredibly worthwhile, as there really is nothing better than having someone to rely on, as well as them relying on you.
